Kill [[Myish, Lady of the Lake]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Kill Myish, Lady of the Lake in [[Drakkar Lake]].
* *BONUS* Kill Myish in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* 500 [[Norn rank|Norn reputation points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
As per [[Myish, Lady of the Lake#Notes|Myish, Lady of the Lake]].

== Dialogues ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
;Zaishen Bounty
: ''"Kill Myish, Lady of the Lake in Drakkar Lake."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.

=== Reward dialogue ===
;Zehnchu
:''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

== Notes ==
*Consider completing this quest at the same time as the [[Worthy Deeds (Done Dirt Cheap)]] quest, since it also requires you to kill her as one objective.
